# Reference outputs of Finglass 0.3.4

These files record what Finglass 0.3.4 computed for fixed inputs. The Go code must reproduce them byte for byte; the
tests next to each package compare against them. They were generated by the 0.3.4 code (commit `feb4b79`), not
written by hand, and are frozen: a change to one of them is a behaviour change and needs a reason in its PR.

The one exception is `i18n/keys.json`, which the Go i18n tests keep in line with the current keys.

## Inputs

`testdata/inputs/<area>/` holds the inputs. The statement files are copies of test statements or synthetic statements.
No real account data is used.

## Files

All files are pretty-printed JSON with two-space indentation and a trailing newline.

| File | What it records |
|---|---|
| `import/statements.json` | Every file in `testdata/inputs/import/` read as a statement on 2026-10-15: detected format, labels, IBANs, skipped rows, pending count, the CSV layout, the camt closing balance and every booking. Covers each CSV bank preset (Sparkasse, ING, DKB, HVB card, comdirect, Commerzbank, N26, FinDesk's export), detection without a file extension, MT940, camt.052, camt.053, a camt ZIP, OFX SGML/XML, QIF and XLSX. |
| `hash/hashes.json` | Transaction and import hashes for every booking of every import golden, plus edge cases: empty partner/purpose, umlauts, NFC vs NFD, trailing spaces, a negative zero, `0.10` vs `0.1`, newlines and tabs. |
| `dedup/reports.json` | Duplicate decisions on overlapping statements: first import, re-import, an overlapping file, and a re-import after a deleted booking, with every count, the balance, the summary text and the stored rows. |
| `format/formats.json` | Money, whole money, percent, shares, date, date-time and IBAN formatting in EN, DE and FR; date, decimal and amount parsing over valid and invalid strings; decimal parsing and plain formatting per currency. |
| `iban/ibans.json` | Normalising, validating, formatting and masking the 47 strings in `testdata/inputs/iban/ibans.txt`. |
| `rules/files.json` | Parsing and writing every rule file in `testdata/inputs/rules/` (round trip, BOM + CRLF, comments, every row error, the import workflow file, the default rule set). |
| `rules/matcher.json` | Rule decisions on the 110 bookings in `testdata/inputs/rules/bookings.csv` over the 12 default rules, plus the PayPal/shop cases. |
| `rules/payment_providers.json` | Payment-provider shop, title and merchant detection (marker, pre-comma, card, top-up and non-PayPal cases). |
| `bank_text/bookings.json` | Display partner, purpose, description and secondary line for every booking of every import golden. |
| `balance/charts.json` | Running balances and balance histories of three multi-month statements, including the bank differences. |
| `recurring/detections.json` | Recurring-payment detection and the next 30 days on monthly, quarterly and irregular histories, with today = 2026-10-15. |
| `receipt/receipts.json` | Receipt parsing (total, date, every distinct amount) of the 22 receipt texts in `testdata/inputs/receipt/`. |
| `dashboard/months.json` | The dashboard for October, September, July (no bookings) and January 2026 (carry-forward) over a throwaway encrypted database with three imported statements, the default categories and rules, and two budgets. |
| `report/reports.json` | The yearly, tax and monthly reports for 2025 and 2026, plus category sums and shares in EN and DE. |
| `export/exports.json` | The CSV export text for 2026 in EN and DE (with the UTF-8 BOM), the cell values of the tax-bookings XLSX, and the extracted text and page count of the tax-bookings and report PDFs. |
| `i18n/keys.json` | Every i18n key, sorted by name, with its EN, DE and FR text. |
| `bank_directory/lookups.json` | Parsing `testdata/inputs/bank_directory/blz-test.txt` and FinTS bank-code lookups, including the HypoVereinsbank branch that maps to the central BLZ. |

The top-level `*.json` files (connection settings, migrations, keychain account names, passphrase vectors, PDF text,
the regex corpus) are older reference files of the same kind.

## Randomness

Nothing in these files is random: no paths, timestamps, UUIDs or salts are recorded.
